name: Harness Kit
description: HarnessKit is a professional-grade engineering framework that empowers AI agents with a robust 'harness' of structured controls and specialized personas. Built on the principles of Harness Engineering, it enforces a disciplined development workflow—from domain-driven scope refinement to strict TDD implementation and Socratic technical reviews—ensuring your AI assistant maintains architectural integrity, comprehensive test coverage, and persistent project memory throughout the entire software lifecycle.
longDescription:
Ships **9 skills** and **10 agents**.

- **Skills** (9): `adversarial-qa` (Autonomous Adversarial QA agent), `autonomous-orchestrator` (Sovereign loop manager), `harness-evaluator` (Harness performance evaluator), `harness-tracer` (Execution trace recorder), `meta-harness` (Autonomous Meta-Harness proposer), `project-memory` (Technical documentation specialist), `scope-refinement` (DDD Scope Refinement Orchestrator — coordinates all Domain-Driven Design phases from business discovery to test scenario specification and…), `tdd-orchestrator` (Orchestrates development workflow using Test-Driven Development (TDD) methodology), and 1 more
- **Agents** (10): `cto` (Chief Technology Officer for the autonomous-orchestrator), `developer-backend` (Senior Backend Developer specialized in TDD, API design, database modeling, security, and performance), `developer-debugging` (Systematic Investigation and Debugging Specialist), `developer-devops` (Senior DevOps/Platform Engineer specialized in CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, containerization, observability, and release automation), `developer-frontend` (Senior Frontend Developer specialized in TDD, UI/UX implementation, accessibility, and performance), `developer-qa` (Senior QA Engineer specialized in test strategy, automation, exploratory testing, and quality gates), `harness-qa` (Adversarial QA specialist for the autonomous-orchestrator pipeline), `harness-tech-lead` (Senior Tech Lead and Software Architect specialist for the autonomous-orchestrator pipeline), and 2 more

Installs with `claude plugin install harness-kit@claude-community` from `romabeckman/harness-kit`.
